messages:
Lina: Quick life update — I got married last Saturday (small courthouse thing + tacos 🌮). I also legally changed my last name to Park-Brown, so you might see that pop up on calendar invites or approval flows. I'll keep my old email for a bit but wanted to give a heads-up. I'm bringing snacks next Wed to celebrate — vote: :doughnut: for donuts, :cake: for cake, :tamale: for tamales (or reply with ideas).
Alex: Huge congrats Lina!!! So happy for you ❤️
Priya: Congrats!!! :confetti_ball: Donuts all the way. I can bring the coffee.
Evan: Congratulations! I'll bring a vegan pack so folks have options. Can we label things for allergies?
deploy-bot: Automated congrats — 🎉 Congratulations Lina — best wishes!
Lina: Thanks everyone! I'll order a mix (half vegan donuts + a tamale tray). Priya, could you make the calendar invite? Also who should I ping to update org chart and Slack display name?
Alex: Ping people-ops (cc @people-ops). I can help with the org chart update if you want.
Priya: Done — invite created: "Lina Park-Brown: Name Change + Tiny Wedding Snacks" Wed 10:30am in kitchen. I added a vegan tag and an allergy note. RSVP there.
Evan: RSVP'd. Also can we put a tiny sign that says "not a holiday, just Lina's good day" so people don't show up with extended relatives? :joy:
Lina: Hah — love it. Thank you all, this means a lot. See you Wed ❤️
